ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the figure, this is a schematic diagram of a display screen inside a certain Harmony EMU carriage from Xi'an to Zhengzhou that can display relevant information in real time. The data at positions A and B in the figure respectively represent two physical quantities. Which of the following statements is correct? (　　)
A. Position A represents time, and position B represents average velocity
B. Position A represents time, and position B represents instantaneous velocity
C. Position A represents an instant, and position B represents average velocity
D. Position A represents an instant, and position B represents instantaneous velocity
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Multi-Physics open-ended question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, what physical quantity does the data at position A on the EMU carriage display screen represent?

claims.canonical_value: Position A represents an instant, and position B represents instantaneous velocity
surface_forms: Position A represents an instant, and position B represents instantaneous velocity

normalized_value.answer: Position A represents an instant, and position B represents instantaneous velocity

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, what physical quantity does the data at position A on the EMU carriage display screen represent?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the schematic diagram of the display screen, there are two labeled arrows “A” and “B” at the top. The arrow for A points to the data “19:50” on the left; the arrow for B points to the data “201 km/h” on the right; below there is also “interior temperature (Int): +22 ℃”. Reasoning: The question asks what physical quantity the data at position A represents. Position A corresponds to “19:50”, which is composed of hours and minutes and is a clock reading, representing a specific point in time, rather than a time interval of how long something has lasted, nor velocity or temperature. Therefore, the physical quantity represented by the data at position A is an instant.
